label: resourceUsage
description: A resource usage item, such as peak memory

label: Treecript metrics
description: Metrics which can be gathered by Treecript

label: Res
description: Resident set size — non-swapped physical memory (matches top RES)

label: CPU
description: CPU utilization as a percentage (can exceed 100% for multithreaded processes)

label: Memory
description: RSS memory as a percentage of total physical system memory

label: Children_User
description: User time of child processes (always 0 on Windows/macOS)

label: Children_System
description: System time of child processes (always 0 on Windows/macOS)

label: IO
description: Time waiting for blocking I/O (Linux only)

label: uss
description: Unique Set Size — memory freed if this process terminated now

label: processor_num
description: Number of unique CPU processors used

label: core_num
description: Number of unique CPU cores used

label: cpu_num
description: Number of unique physical CPUs used
